title: Sunset Confession
style: acoustic indie folk, warm fingerpicked guitar, soft male vocal, brushed snare, intimate, romantic, golden hour, light strings
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
The sun is laying gold across your skin
I've been holding back the words I'm holding in
The wind is talking soft through cottonwood
Saying everything I never could

[Verse 2]
You're tracing circles on the back of my hand
I'm trying not to break, trying not to land
But every steady breath you take from me
Feels like an ocean wanting to be sea

[Chorus]
So I'll tell you in the sunset
Where the colors won't forget
I have loved you all along
Even before I knew the song
I'll tell you in the sunset
With the sky as my witness
That my heart has only known
One true home

[Verse 3]
I used to think that love was something loud
A city skyline shouting through a crowd
But you taught me it's the quiet kind that stays
The slow horizon turning into days

[Chorus]
So I'll tell you in the sunset
Where the colors won't forget
I have loved you all along
Even before I knew the song
I'll tell you in the sunset
With the sky as my witness
That my heart has only known
One true home

[Outro]
One true home
That's where you are
My quiet evening star
